closedQuestions.decision: prepare remains an internal structural lifecycle event and is not a StandardActionId, independent Run/Result, user-visible stage, or ordinary STOP boundary
no current Foundation happy-path or independent current capability requires resumed; exact Run occurrence already distinguishes repeated execution

proposalClarifications: A complete Standard Action invocation may internally establish CurrentAction/prepared when no exact prepared current Action already exists.

After admission failure leaves exact same current Action prepared, a later authorized re-execution may reuse that prepared current Action with a new exact Run occurrence rather than issuing duplicate prepare A.
Do not reintroduce resumed merely to model retry/re-execution, and do not add crash-recovery/retry infrastructure in this Change.
